title: Bike Service Receipts
user: Everyday cyclists maintaining one or more bikes who need a simple, evidence-backed record of what was done, what it cost, and what is next.
smallest_useful_product: Offline-first PWA with bike profiles, one-tap service receipts (actions, photo, cost, odometer), rule-based reminders, and CSV/PDF export.
success_measure: After 60 days, 70% of pilot riders have logged three or more maintenance events and can answer the last-service date for every tracked component.
constraints: Local storage/export first; reminders are informational, not safety certification; no medical or repair advice; users control all location/ride imports.
